description: This file defines the ChallengePrompt class which implements the ChallengePromptInterface. It constructs prompt objects with properties like title, placeholder, validation logic based on ChallengeValidation, and other configuration options for challenge prompts in the application.

classes.name: ChallengePrompt
classes.description: Represents a prompt used in challenge scenarios, with configurable validation, UI text, keyboard type, and initial value. Implements ChallengePromptInterface.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a ChallengePrompt instance with validation rules, title, placeholder, security, keyboard type, initial value, and context data. Sets these fields based on provided parameters and ChallengeValidation enum cases.
